High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 5829 of 2024

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Vishal Agarwal
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Dhiraj Kumar Pandey,G.A.
Hon'ble Shekhar Kumar Yadav,J.
1.
Heard Mr. Vishal Agarwal, learned counsel for the applicant, learned Additional Government Advocate for the State and Mr. Dhiraj Kumar Pandey, learned counsel for the informant.

2. This anticipatory bail application (under section 438 Cr.P.C.) has been moved seeking anticipatory bail in Case Crime No.521 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 323, 328, 307 IPC and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Sadar Bazar, District Saharanpur.

3. During arguments, learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that a direction may be issued to the court below to decide the bail application of the applicant in view of the judgment in the case Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, 2021 SCC Online SC 922.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, 2021 SCC Online SC 922
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the present anticipatory bail application is disposed of with the direction that in case the applicant appears and surrenders before the court below and applies for bail, the same shall be heard and disposed of, expeditiously, in view of the settled law laid by this Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil (Supra).
5.
The present anticipatory bail application stands disposed of.
